meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Runs maximum-saturation research with a cooperating team, claim-graph gating, and a cited, QA'd deliverable. Use when the user explicitly asks for research or a deep investigation, including any 'ulw' research wording.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把你抛出的问题查透,交付带出处和质检的结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面对复杂问题想要得到论证充分的结论
copy.tagline_en: Conduct exhaustive research on any topic and return a cited, QA'd report
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a deep, verified answer to any hard question

howto.what: 接到明确研究请求后,它进入 ULW-RESEARCH 模式:自划研究轴、组建协作团队分头检索、用辩论互攻争议结论、跑代码验证,最后交付每条说法都带引用或证据的成果(默认 PDF+DOCX)。
howto.when: 当你明确要求研究或深度调查,或提到 “ulw-research”、“ulw” 研究措辞、ultradebate 等关键词时触发;普通提问与调试不触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 帮我彻底研究一下这个问题
say.note: 会先问你想要的交付格式再开工

say.text: 对 X 做一次深度调查,给我一份带引用的报告
say.note: 团队分头检索,结论逐条带引用

say.text: 这些结论有争议,用 ulw-research 辩论并跑代码验证
say.note: 发起辩论并执行验证脚本

howto.what_en: When you explicitly ask for research, it enters ULW-RESEARCH mode: scopes axes, stands up a cooperating team, fans out, debates contested claims, proves them with code, and delivers a cited, QA'd artifact (PDF+DOCX by default).
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly request research or a deep investigation — e.g. 'ulw-research', any 'ulw' research wording, or ultradebate/hyperdebate. Ordinary questions and debugging do not trigger it.

say_en.text: Run ulw-research to investigate this topic exhaustively
say_en.note: Enters the mode and asks your delivery format first

say_en.text: Do a deep investigation of X and give me a cited report
say_en.note: Team fans out; synthesis carries citations

say_en.text: These claims are contested — debate them and verify with code
say_en.note: Runs debate rounds and verification scripts
